windows.notes:
Refract 1.5.2 is a big update for Mac, Windows and Linux.

The shortcut now works from just being in a text box, with nothing highlighted, and the rewrite pastes back far more reliably, including in apps that do not expose their text. Only real password fields are skipped; no app, window or label blocks a rewrite any more. The button stays where you park it and no longer follows Send or your selection.

While a rewrite runs, a calm orb of soft light drifts inside the button with a light ring circling the rim (Mac and Windows). The post-rewrite message stays while you hover over it, right-click menus stay on screen near the edges, and the menu-bar and tray icon is a new 3D pyramid. "Always use <Preset> in <App>" is now in the right-click and menu-bar menus on every platform.

Settings are reorganised into clear pages with a model browser (pick a provider, search, favourite, refresh and use a model for all presets, one preset or as a backup) and a Test & Diagnostics page that checks models, providers, capture and paste, shortcuts, Jev, the free route and updates. Linux gains a tray icon and a Check for updates menu item.

Jev, your optional TypeSafe checker, can now fix a flagged rewrite once, with a Fix it button in Review. It stays optional and off by default; the check of the pinned model works again with TypeSafe's current model list.

Microsoft Store updates are separate. Refract Free depends on a relay that is not live yet.
